description: This file defines the AboutOrganizationModel class used in the OrangeHRM system's REST API to model organization information, including properties like company name, product name, version, and employee counts. It implements the Normalizable interface for serialization purposes and uses traits for user role management.

classes.name: AboutOrganizationModel
classes.description: A model class representing organization details for REST API responses, including serialization logic and role-based data exposure.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an AboutOrganization data transfer object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the model to an array, including employee counts only if the user role is 'Admin'.
